branding.tagline: Excellence in Academics, Character, Digital Innovation & Leadership

hero.headline: Shaping Tomorrow's Leaders Through Academic Excellence
hero.subheadline: Welcome to Apex Comprehensive College, Ikeja. Fostering holistic student development, curriculum mastery, character building, and digital literacy.

content.description: Apex Comprehensive College, Ikeja is dedicated to fostering an intellectually stimulating, disciplined, and nurturing environment where every learner thrives.
bulletPoints: Full statutory alignment with NERDC 2026 national curriculum frameworks
Modern digital laboratory suites and interactive computer-based learning
Holistic extracurricular programs in sports, debate, robotics, and creative arts

items.title: Junior Secondary School (JSS 1 - JSS 3)
items.description: Foundation courses in sciences, humanities, vocational entrepreneurship, and digital literacy with continuous NERDC-guided formative assessments.

items.title: Senior Secondary School (SS 1 - SS 3)
items.description: Specialized departmental tracks in Science & Mathematics, Arts & Humanities, and Commercial Business Studies preparing scholars for WAEC, NECO, and JAMB.

items.title: STEM & Robotics Laboratory
items.description: Practical coding, artificial intelligence concepts, electronics prototyping, and computer-assisted science experiments.

content.description: Applications for the upcoming academic session are now open. Prospective students must register online and sit for the computer-based entrance examination.

items.title: 1. Online Application Form
items.description: Submit applicant biodata, previous academic transcripts, and birth certification via the digital portal.

items.title: 2. Entrance Assessment
items.description: Candidates sit for the computer-based entrance evaluation in Mathematics, English, and General Aptitude.

items.title: 3. Offer & Digital Clearance
items.description: Successful applicants receive an automated provisional admission letter and student clearance invoice.

items.title: 2026 Academic Session Resumption Date
items.description: All boarding students are expected to resume on Sunday, while day students commence classes on Monday 8:00 AM prompt.

items.title: Continuous Assessment Tests Schedule
items.description: First Mid-Term CAT will be conducted using the School Computer-Based Testing Kiosk from Wednesday through Friday.

sections.title: Digital Campus Access
sections.subtitle: Secure Self-Service for All Institutional Stakeholders

items.title: Teacher Delivery Tracker
items.description: Lesson plan submission, attendance logging, and student progress reports.

items.title: Student Terminal Results
items.description: Real-time terminal broadsheet review, e-report card downloads, and past CBT review.

items.title: Parent Fee Clearance
items.description: Instant school fee settlement via Paystack/OPay with tamper-evident digital receipts.

authPresentation.welcomeSubtext: Sign in with your verified institutional identity to access your academic records, course notes, assessments, and fee management.
authPresentation.customHelpText: For institutional credential recovery or enrollment support, contact the ICT Academic Helpdesk.
